body:
Here is my first experence with diphenhidrimine. For a bit of backround I am a 14 year old board kid trying out new drugs. So, to the point, I had 12 25 mg pills of diphenhidramine (300mg).
T+30mins I start to feel fatigue and a bit confused.
T+1hour This is when the trip started I felt tired a bit sick and light headed.
This feeling lasted for about 2-3 hours and then I started to stare in the space with wide open eyes like a retard for an hour. Music was not fun. Nothing was fun.
Conclusion: Bad trip No visuals no any positive aspects.
